objective: Require a typed bring-up record for a BSP readiness PASS, so an existing repository file can no longer be cited as evidence.
acceptance: a PASS gate's evidence is parsed as a YAML bring-up record, not accepted because the path exists
the record carries the fields the committed bring-up plan declares plus gate, board_model, source_revision and raw_capture binding fields
a blank, placeholder or malformed value keeps the gate non-PASS
a non-PASS result inside the record keeps the gate non-PASS
a raw_capture that is not repository-relative or escapes the repository is refused
a sha256 that does not recompute keeps the gate non-PASS
a generic README.md can no longer mark every gate PASS
the schema is read from bringup-plan.yaml rather than a hardcoded per-gate list
evidence: the README.md mutation script prints a structured-record failure for each of the nine gates plus the release-flag and package-status failures, where it previously printed []
stop_conditions: a code special case would be needed for one gate
an interface schema under interfaces/ would have to change
a physical claim would have to be asserted without a capture
